(()=>{const out={};const tr=PT8.RING_IDX;PT8.launch({mode:'mp',rally:true,circuit:true,track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[]});const c=RACE.cars[0];c.forceAI=1;c.ai={skill:1,lat:0,name:'T'};const T=RACE.T,N=T.N;const q=new THREE.Quaternion(),e=new THREE.Euler(0,0,0,'YXZ'),v=new THREE.Vector3();let n=0,F=0,Rr=0,pit=0,sl=0,vy=0,hist=[0,0,0,0,0,0];for(let i=0;i<60*240;i++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count'&&i>60*20)RACE.state='race';if(RACE.state!=='race'||c.sp<20)continue;const k=c.idx,g=(T.y[(k+4)%N]-T.y[k])/(4*T.sp);if(g>-.05)continue;e.set(c.pitch,c.yaw,c.roll);q.setFromEuler(e);const gp=[];for(let w=0;w<4;w++){v.set(WL[w][0],-.1,WL[w][1]).applyQuaternion(q);const s=T.surf(c.x+v.x,c.z+v.z,c.y+v.y);gp.push(c.y+v.y-(s.h+RW)-L0)}n++;F+=(gp[0]+gp[1])/2;Rr+=(gp[2]+gp[3])/2;pit+=c.pitch;sl+=Math.atan(g);vy+=c.vy;const mn=Math.min(...gp);hist[mn<0?0:mn<.1?1:mn<.25?2:mn<.45?3:mn<1?4:5]++}return JSON.stringify({n,front:+(F/n).toFixed(3),rear:+(Rr/n).toFixed(3),pitch:+(pit/n).toFixed(3),slope:+(sl/n).toFixed(3),vy:+(vy/n).toFixed(2),hist})})()
